messages.subject: The condition to apply INLA-SPDE in a real case
parts:
Dear inla group

I am a beginner of INLA, so I ask some "silly" questions. 
I intend to use INLA-SPDE to study a small zone (150km*100km) with 8000 observations. The use model is a sptiotemporal hierarchical model.(AR1+SPDE)
I am not sure that the study area (and 8000 observations) are large enough to apply SPDE-INLA?
The idea is that since the SPDE approach is a comprise between computational complexity and accuracy, is it necessary to use the INLA-SPDE algorithm to study such small zone? 

Thanks
